item.title: 20-year-old seriously injured after car plunges into ravine near Tayibe
item.description:
Three people were injured after a vehicle plunged into a ravine along Route 5614, near the entrance to Tayibe.
Magen David Adom reported that a 20-year-old man was seriously injured, rendered unconscious with multi-system trauma. Another 20-year-old man sustained moderate injuries with abdominal trauma, and a third individual was also injured in the incident. All victims were evacuated to Meir Hospital in Kfar Saba.

item.title: 17-year-old loses consciousness at Tzfat pool, is in serious condition
item.description:
A 17-year-old boy lost consciousness at a swimming pool in Tzfat, reportedly due to a medical episode.
Magen David Adom paramedics and EMTs provided him with emergency medical treatment and evacuated him to Ziv Hospital in serious condition.

item.title: IDF soldier severely injured by gunfire at military base
item.description:
An IDF soldier was severely injured on Tuesday evening as a result of gunfire at a military base in central Israel.
The soldier was evacuated to a hospital for medical treatment, and his family was notified. Following the incident, the Military Police Criminal Investigation Division launched an investigation, the findings of which will be submitted to the Military Advocate General's Corps for review.
